# Pin what the password, hidden, search, display and switch fields change

> [!NOTE]
> **Held in the #18985 reserve: not open for claiming yet.** Curated issues are released in batches as review capacity frees up. Please pick an issue labelled `good first issue` instead.
> This one is also being moved to the **component tier** first: it tests something a human looks at, and #18985's tier rule sends those to a real browser.

## Welcome 👋

Five of Neo's form fields are *presets*: a base field with a few configs changed. A password field is a text field whose input has `type="password"`; a display field is a read-only text field. Each is a handful of lines, and none has a test. One spec can pin all five, and you will see how Neo builds a field along the way.

This is a **good first issue** for Hacktoberfest 2026. It needs Node.js and a clone of this repository: no Docker, no AI setup.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Reserved for first-time Neo.mjs contributors.** The maintainer team will not claim, edit, or implement this issue through **2026-10-31**. Comment here to claim it, and ask anything on this issue.

**Set up once:** follow [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone), including `npm run bundle-browser-deps`: without it the unit suite selects zero tests.

## Where things live

- Sources: `src/form/field/Password.mjs`, `Hidden.mjs`, `Search.mjs`, `Display.mjs`, `Switch.mjs`
- New test file: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/FieldPresets.spec.mjs`
- Pattern to copy: `test/playwright/unit/form/field/InputWidth.spec.mjs` (creating a field in a unit test). `field.getInputEl()` returns the virtual-DOM node of the `<input>`.

## What to cover

| Field | Expected |
|---|---|
| `Password` | `ntype` is `'passwordfield'`, and the input's `type` is `'password'` |
| `Hidden` | `ntype` is `'hiddenfield'`, and `hidden` is `true` |
| `Search` | `ntype` is `'searchfield'`; `baseCls` is `['neo-searchfield', 'neo-textfield']`; `hideLabel` is `true`; `placeholderText` is `'Search'` |
| `Display` | `ntype` is `'displayfield'` and `clearable` is `false`; the input is `readonly` with `tabindex` `'-1'` |
| `Switch` | `ntype` is `'switchfield'`; `baseCls` is `['neo-switchfield', 'neo-checkboxfield']`; the input carries the `neo-switchfield-input` class |

## Done when

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/form/field/FieldPresets.spec.mjs` exists, following the pattern file's setup.
- [ ] One `test(...)` per field.
- [ ] Test-only: if a field disagrees with its row, say so on this issue before changing `src/`.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/form/field/FieldPresets.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` passes.

## Out of scope

The base `Text` and `CheckBox` fields, validation, and styling.

## While you wait for review

You just pinned one small piece of a multi-threaded application engine: in Neo.mjs your app's code runs inside a web worker, and the main thread only paints. Two things worth ten minutes:

- **See the part nobody expects.** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `npm run server-start`, open `apps/workstation/`, and drag a tab out of the browser window. It becomes its own OS window, still running, with the same component instances and the same worker. [Benefits: Introduction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md) explains why that is possible.
- **Your coding agent can go much further here.** The skills this repository's AI maintainers work with are published on npm as [`neo-agent-skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neo-agent-skills), and they need no Knowledge Base and no Memory Core. With Claude or GPT beside you, the `help wanted` issues are within reach after this one.
